**Pairing-card request could not be delivered by machine — relay is with the maintainer.** Attempted channels from this seat, both refused: `objectstack-ai/cloud` is outside this session's GitHub authorization (add_repo: no access; list_repos: zero cloud hits), and a poke trigger to the cloud seat's session was rejected (that session belongs to a different account — the seat's assignee is baozhoutao). Per the cross-repo linked-card convention the producer half is the cloud seat's to file; the request text is ready in this card's Pairing section. **One relay action closes this**: the maintainer (or baozhoutao) tells the cloud seat 「按 objectstack#12865 立配对卡」 — the back-link comment here is the receipt. Until that comment lands, this card's Pairing section is the only carrier of the producer half; the unlock scan should treat a missing back-link at unpark time as a pre-flight blocker, not a reason to ship the SDK half alone.

## Unpark ruling + epic delegation (2026-08-28)

Maintainer instruction received in live PM chat, verbatim (Chinese, quoted as spoken):

> 作为 epic 卡，处理所有相关任务和开发

This satisfies this card's machine-readable restart clause — "Restart-when: a maintainer ruling on this card declares the next SDK/protocol breaking major open". The maintainer has directed full execution of all related tasks and development, which opens the D2 window. Unparking now: `pm:on-hold` comes off, `pm:epic` goes on, and this card becomes the epic parent (coordination node — never dispatched itself).

Epic PM: session `session_65d2faee-1ff4-4be8-be28-72b972c539d9`, branch `claude/pm-dispatch-adr-0006-d2-sdk-eb8b61` (maintainer-directed dispatch channel).

### Pre-flight readings (measured on origin/main today, not recalled)

1. **Premise correction on this card's body**: the body says the ADR-0006 addendum was "merged via PR #12736". Measured: PR #12736 is an OPEN DRAFT (governed surface, awaiting human merge). The D1/D2/D3 record is not on main yet. The D1-retirement addendum sub-task is therefore blocked behind that human merge.
2. **Pairing relay is now resolved by seat capability, not maintainer relay**: the earlier comment reported `objectstack-ai/cloud` unreachable — that was the MCP agent channel of a prior seat. This seat's local gh CLI has push access to objectstack-ai/cloud (verified via the repos endpoint). The producer-half pairing card will be filed by this seat directly; its back-link comment below is the receipt.
3. **Producer surface located** (cloud repo, origin/main): `packages/service-cloud/src/routes/environment-crud.ts` produces the `projects`+`total` list envelope and several `project` envelopes; `packages/service-cloud/src/routes/environment-lifecycle.ts` produces further `project` envelopes. URL paths are already on the `environments` spelling (the SDK calls `/api/v1/cloud/environments`); the rename scope is response FIELD keys, exactly as this card's Pairing section says.
4. **Serial constraint**: open PR #12848 (issue #12038, response-contract binding) touches `packages/client/src/index.ts` and `packages/client/exported-any-returns.json` — the same files the SDK half must edit. Its diff does not touch the `projects` block lines, but the baseline file overlaps. SDK-half sub-card serializes behind PR #12848's merge.
5. **Spec is untouched**: zero `projects` envelope contracts in `packages/spec/src` (positive control: `environments` hits exist in spec). Clause-② path limb not engaged; content limb — the spec contract's accept/reject behavior is unchanged; the breaking surface is the SDK package API, already ruled (#12473 option 3, ADR-0006 D2, today's unpark).
6. **The JSDoc's named server class appears to no longer exist**: zero hits for the provisioning-service spelling in cloud's service-cloud package — the SDK-half dev must measure the current truthful wording rather than copy the card's.

Sub-issues follow; each carries its own scope, pins, and blocking edges.

**Pairing back-link receipt**: the producer-half card is filed — objectstack-ai/cloud#1691. The relay this card's earlier comment left with the maintainer is resolved (this seat's local gh has cloud push access; no relay was needed). Sub-issue tree: #12866 (SDK half, serialized behind PR #12848), objectstack-ai/cloud#1691 (producer half, dispatching now), #12867 (D1 retirement addendum, blocked behind PR #12736's human merge).

## Epic COMPLETE on the code side (2026-08-29) — awaiting the maintainer's production cutover

All four sub-issues closed; both rename halves merged under the maintainer's window ruling (「12885 绿了就开窗，按清单执行」):

- [x] #12866 + #12882 — PR #12885 merged 87042b5de (client namespace, unwrap keys, JSDoc, five CLI commands, ScopedEnvironmentClient, no aliases)
- [x] objectstack-ai/cloud#1691 — cloud PR #1692 merged 0591f80a4 (all 8 producer envelope emission sites, no dual keys)
- [x] #12867 — PR #12908 merged (ADR-0006 D1 retired by execution, record on main)
- [x] #12881 — PR #12997 merged (gate predicate fixed)
- [x] Follow-up FILED: objectstack-ai/cloud#1724 (.objectstack-sha bump past 87042b5de + the two client-namespace conformance files, one PR — the cloud seat's standing bump flow)

Staging picks up the renamed wire on its ~30-min timer automatically.

## Remaining: the production cutover — two human acts, done near each other

1. Cut the cloud v* tag and approve the prod deploy (Required-Reviewers gate) — puts the renamed producer on production.
2. Merge the objectstack Version Packages PR carrying the client changeset (minor + BREAKING prose, per the 「不挂 major」 ruling) — publishes the renamed SDK.

From that moment previously-published SDKs break against production, which is the priced-in cost the rulings accepted (smallest caller base now). This checklist stays as the record; the epic parent remains open until the cutover is done.

Closing on maintainer instruction (live PM chat, 2026-08-29, verbatim: 「父卡如果没任务就可以关了」). All four sub-issues are closed, both rename halves are merged (objectstack 87042b5de · cloud 0591f80a4), the D1 retirement record is on main, and the one recorded follow-up lives in its own card (objectstack-ai/cloud#1724). The remaining production cutover (cloud v* tag + prod approval; objectstack Version Packages merge) is the maintainer's standing release machinery, tracked in the final checklist comment above — not an open task on this carrier. ADR-0006 D2: pre-registered → unparked by ruling → executed → D1 retired. Epic closed by session `session_65d2faee-1ff4-4be8-be28-72b972c539d9`.
